label: I see two airplanes.

meanings.ja: 私は二機の飛行機を見ます。

textReview: English two takes plural airplanes, by boat omits an article, and singular taxi/motorcycle take a. Japanese で marks means or activity location, に marks destination or existence location, and を marks the object of waiting. ある is used for an inanimate boat. Omitted Japanese subjects are interpreted as first person. Every previous sentence remains intact.
